title: be report lab configuration (be-lab-config/0.1)
description: The declared fields of a test report that the runner cannot know: the machine, its gate, the software around it, the instruments and their checks, the signer, the operator and the method text. `be report --lab-config` reads it; every member is copied into the report as declared (docs/seams/submission.md). Each definition is the test report 0.1 schema's own, by reference, so the two cannot drift; unknown members are refused everywhere. The instruments' accuracy_check.at and post_run_check.at change from session to session.

machine.description: make, model (or "withheld"), class and, if known, physical_max_tool_speed_mps.

gate.description: The gate under test: name, version and placement (name "none" and placement "none" for an ungated machine).

software.description: Optional: software in the command path besides the kit, core and LeRobot, which be report lists itself.

instruments.description: The instruments, exactly one primary; its samples become raw/samples.csv.gz and its checks raw/accuracy.csv.

signer.description: Who signs; be report adds the kid of the signing key.

operator.description: Who ran the machine: a name or a role (POLICY.md prefers a role).

method.description: The method text the run followed: id, version, text_sha256.
